content: {"reasoning":"The denial is for missing prior authorization, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. A medical-necessity appeal has already been attempted, while resubmission or another unsupported appeal would not cure the authorization defect; patient liability also cannot be determined from the stated 20% coinsurance alone. No available automated action can properly progress the claim, so specialist review is required.","action":"escalate"}
